note: The release plan, for the Product & Program page. Authored, not derived — a target date and what a future release is thematically about are the CEO's calls, and no repository state implies them. What IS derived stays derived: the last shipped release comes from the git tags, and the next release's feature list comes from hq/data/releases.json by release_id. Written 2026-09-04 as a strawman for the CEO to correct.

next.name: Player Update 1
next.contains: The shop, and the first robot you can teach — the beginning of the delegation arc, plus eleven other things a player would notice.

planned.name: Machines that pay for themselves
planned.contains: Automation you place and maintain: sprinkler coverage and overlap, upkeep, and the resource loop behind buying a machine — plus the first group-pest skirmishes to spend it on.

planned.name: Towers and waves
planned.contains: The tower-defense slice. Towers that start out taking orders and end up running themselves, and waves designed against the simulation rather than by hand.

planned.name: A bot that learns from you
planned.contains: The first bot trained on your own recorded sessions, with the overnight training loop running on the tablet itself.

planned.name: The last phase
planned.contains: The genre and interface experiments that close the five-phase arc, then content and polish.
